                $CNDS KEY READ-THROUGHS FROM CADENCE DESIGN SYSTEMS Q2 2026 EARNINGS CALL

Cadence’s Q2 2026 earnings call provided a high-quality, broad-based confirmation that AI infrastructure investment is increasing the number, complexity and strategic importance of semiconductor and system designs rather than merely increasing demand for a narrow group of merchant accelerators. The most important signals were the record $8.1b backlog despite a relatively low renewal year, approximately 24% recurring-revenue growth, normalized recurring growth in the high-teens to approximately 20%, 18% core EDA growth, greater than 40% semiconductor IP growth, another record hardware quarter and 37% System Design and Analysis growth. The breadth indicates that the current cycle is propagating across custom silicon, advanced-node implementation, analog and mixed-signal design, memory interfaces, networking, verification, chiplets, 3DIC, advanced packaging, PCB design and multiphysics simulation. The strongest positive read-throughs are for Cadence, custom-ASIC enablers, memory and interconnect suppliers, advanced-packaging providers and foundries with credible leading-edge ecosystems. The principal negative read-throughs are relative competitive pressure on Synopsys, longer-duration merchant-accelerator share dilution from hyperscaler custom silicon, potential commoditization of the top-layer AI agent interface, Cadence’s H2 margin investment and the explicit export-control assumption embedded in guidance.
